title: Memories
description:
A story of him and her.
You can control both of them.
Figure out what happend to them by collecting papers in the game world.
And find a way out.

Game Feature• Double Main Characters:
Explore levels with them and switch character whenever you want.

• Pazzles:
Pick,combine,think,then use.Solve puzzles.

• Special abilities:
Each charactor has different abilities and gain more by story.

• Multiple endings:
Promote the plot by different action,which leads to a different end.

Some part of this story based on actual events with artistic exaggeration
description_short: A third person double main character adventure-puzzle solving game.Figure out what they forgot and find a way out.
